artifacts.summary: Per-surface findings for all 8 named decidability-prose surfaces: re-verified Compression.decidableValidZTime (axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], standard trust), confirmed each quoted stale/incomplete phrase and its exact lines, and recommended additive prose fixes stating the two-statement distinction once per surface, pointing to docs/theorem-index.md.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, FormalSystem.Semantics.validZTime_iff_validInt (FormalSystem/Semantics/IntTransfer.lean:338) formally identifies 'validity over every discrete duration carrier' with 'validity over Z alone' (ValidZTime). This is the Lean counterpart of the typst paper's Log(Discrete) notion, so any proved property of ValidZTime (e.g. decidability) can be stated as a property of the paper-level Discrete factor logic, not just of a same-named Lean predicate.

BimodalLogic has no mechanical lint tying a landed Lean decidability result to the fixed set of prose surfaces that assert decidability status (README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, Decidability/README.md, Decidability.lean docstring, BiLasso/README.md, ADR-007, known-limitations.md, typst/FormalFoundations.typ). A result landing in WitnessFamily/Compression/Assembly.lean on 2026-09-28 left several of these surfaces stale/false for about a week before a dedicated reconciliation task caught it. A future meta-type task could add a doc-staleness check to check-module-invariants.sh triggered when a new Decidable def/instance lands under Metalogic/Decidability/.
